name: xy-pad
title: XY Pad
author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>
description: Two-dimensional pad for setting two values at once by dragging or with the arrow keys. Used for offsets, positions and paired parameters.

meta.example: <XYPad value={offset} onChange={setOffset} x={{ min: -50, max: 50, step: 1 }} y={{ min: -50, max: 50, step: 1 }} />
